name: io.github.wazzapsenk/steamworks-mcp
title: Steamworks Release Assistant
description: Put a game on Steam: store page, achievements, Valve-rule checks, market data, Steamworks.

environmentVariables.name: STEAMWORKS_MCP_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: The folder that holds your game projects. Default: the folder the app starts the server in.

environmentVariables.name: STEAMWORKS_PUBLISHER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Steamworks publisher Web API key, only for builds, beta branches and leaderboards.
